newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan aluminium output rises in March.
newsitem.headline: Japan aluminium output rises in March.

text.p: Output of aluminium sheet and extruded products by Japan's seven largest makers totalled 144,328 tonnes in March, up 17,047 tonnes from February and up 8,232 tonnes from a year earlier, an industry body said on Thursday.

Of the March total, production of aluminium sheets, used mainly in cars and cans, totalled 114,566 tonnes, up 15,164 from the previous month and up 5,687 tonnes from a year earlier, the Japan Aluminium Federation said.
Output of extruded products, used in the construction sector, totalled 29,762 tonnes, up 1,883 tonnes from the previous month and up 2,545 tonnes from a year earlier.
